name: AI webform submission sentiment detection
description: Analyzes webform submissions for sentiment using AI, storing a numeric score per submission and charting the trend with Chart.js.
project_description: AI Webform Sentiment adds a Webform handler plugin that queues every non-draft submission for AI sentiment analysis. On cron, a queue worker sends each submission's data to a configurable LLM (via the AI module's chat operation) with a prompt that asks for a single numeric score (default 0-5). The integer result is stored in a dedicated ai_webform_sentiment database table, and a per-webform 'Sentiment' results tab renders average, daily-trend, and distribution charts with Chart.js (via chartjs_api). Scoring granularity is controlled entirely by the editable prompt. Requires cron to be running; each submission costs one LLM call.
